title: Opening holdings, negative-dollar fix, breakdowns by sector, asset type, currency and market
changes: Buy form: 'holding from before tracking began' — builds the position without touching tracked cash; its cost counts as capital brought in, so profit is not inflated by its value

Cash screen: opening capital card; when dollar cash is negative, an explanation and a one-click balancing currency conversion, filled with the ECB rate of the first dollar trade's date for the user to check
Holdings: breakdown by symbol, sector, asset type, currency or market (weights in ₪ including cash)
Instrument details (name, sector, asset type) editable from the holdings table; used only for breakdowns
Holdings card wording: unrealized profit 'by the latest prices'
